The '''Paqwepor Major system''', also known as the '''Paqwepor system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[Paqwepori]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the world of [[Paqwepor Major]].
